# hunch find: examples

`find` scores every chunk of the repository against a task. It needs no rules, and no config at all.

<!-- case: find-dry -->
### What would a search cost?

```sh
npx @kelbie/hunch find "make payment retries configurable" --dry-run
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text
hunch: dry run, nothing sent. 3 file(s) as 3 chunk(s): 3 request(s), 15 question(s).
```
